ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution consists of approximately 60% low-intensity (black) and 40% high-intensity (white) pixels, exhibiting high edge contrast between pigmentation zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is predominantly solid black with a vertical white streak near the notch and scattered white speckling. Right lobe contains a large, contiguous white irregular blob covering the distal half and central region, intersected by black dendritic patterns originating from the leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 80 degrees at the vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography; right lobe features 5-6 distinct high-amplitude peaks (serrations); left lobe shows a higher frequency of low-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the distal trailing edge ending in acute, pointed lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, roughly circular white pixel clusters (approximately 3-8 pixels in diameter) scattered across the black pigmented areas, most concentrated on the mid-to-lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: One large, tan-colored, high-relief circular protrusion (acorn barnacle) is attached to the lateral boundary of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge of the right lobe exhibits significant irregular tissue loss, creating a jagged, 'torn' profile compared to the more uniform serration of the left lobe.
